description: Small headless DRAW subset plus explicit capability/data sentinels. Expected unsupported/missing statuses satisfy the coverage contract but are never counted as passes. Review any changed expectation.

cases.purpose: Disjoint AABBs, both operand orders.
Contained AABBs, both operand orders.
Overlapping AABBs, both operand orders.
Oriented bounding boxes; capability sentinel.
Boolean common of wire compounds; capability sentinel.
Boolean union of wire compounds; capability sentinel.
Restores a face and extrudes it with prism (no Copy): native evaluates every geometric assertion (its image commands are recorded); a Rust capability sentinel.
Face split by edges, then rebuilt and queried with modified. Capability sentinel for M3: faces from mkface, lines and edges are outside the prism adapter.
Face fuse, split by an edge and rebuilt with bbuild; history is not consulted beyond counts. Capability sentinel for M3: the adapter has no face-level Booleans.
Derived: prism history (generated, modified, isdeleted) of a rectangle's edges, vertices and face.
Derived: prism history against a clockwise profile's normal.
Derived: cylinder counts (seam edge and vertices) through the count synthesizer, and properties.
Derived: cone and frustum counts (seam, seam vertex and the apex's degenerated edge) through the count synthesizer, and certified properties.
Derived: whole sphere, hemisphere and zone counts (seam, pole vertices and degenerated edges) through the count synthesizer, and certified properties.
Derived: whole torus, wedge and half counts (seams in u and v) through the count synthesizer, and certified properties.
Derived: explode picks of a box and a cylinder selected by native geometry (native selector); the seam pick is lost.
Original restore-and-check case on the public dataset (REVIEW_NOTES.md S2).
Original restore-and-check case on the public dataset (REVIEW_NOTES.md S2).
Original restore-and-check case on the public dataset: a whole sphere restored, counted and measured (S3 of REVIEW_NOTES.md).
Derived: prisms of profiles with arcs (S5) built by upstream's profile sketch command: tangent half circles, fillets and a clockwise notch; counts and properties.

Derived: faces and edges on DRAW geometry (S6): mkface on a plane and a cylinder (a patch and the whole band), mkedge on a line and a circle (segments and the whole circle), and mkplane of a profile wire with arcs; counts and properties of free faces and edges.
S7 (lowalgos): a torus and a plane through its axis, two meridian circles; dump, bounds, dval and xdistcs on both surfaces.
S7 (lowalgos): a torus and a plane through its axis, two meridian circles; dump, bounds, dval and xdistcs on both surfaces.
S7 (lowalgos): a cone and a coaxial torus, circles; dump must name each a circle.

S7 (lowalgos), a recorded divergence: two cylinders whose axes are antiparallel only up to rounding; OCCT snaps them to parallel and reports two lines, the kernel's exact predicates find crossing axes and one closed curve, and the case then calls the undefined command `Error:`.

Derived: OCCT's splitter (bclearobjects, bcleartools, baddobjects, baddtools, bfillds, bsplit, bapisplit) with one plane face as the tool on a prism, a sheet with arcs and a closed wire, singly and together (S8e): checkshape, counts with the pieces' shared cut faces, chords and crossings, and properties per use.

Derived: Booleans of prisms in one frame (S9a) through bfuse, bcut, bcommon, bop with bopfuse/bopcut/boptuc/bopcommon, and bbop/bapibop on the General Fuse arguments: overlapping boxes, a box and a pcylinder (a half cylinder, a hole), a box cut in two, disjoint boxes (two solids, an empty common), one box inside another, stacked boxes of one profile and a stadium prism with a bar; checkshape, volumes and areas on the result, counts and lengths per use after unifysamedom.

Derived: Booleans of prisms in one frame whose slabs hold different regions (S9a.2's stacks) through bfuse, bcut, bop with bopfuse/bopcut and bbop: a step, a pocket, a box cut into two solids by a slab, a closed cavity (one solid of two shells) and a tool through a round wall; checkshape, volumes and areas on the result, counts and lengths per use after unifysamedom.
S8e's bsplit group, a capability sentinel for S9's general builder: a shell split by three restored faces (bsplit); its data file is not in the public dataset (Open Cascade's private test data).
S8e's bsplit group, a capability sentinel for S9's general builder: the same through bapisplit; its data file is not in the public dataset (Open Cascade's private test data).

S8e's bsplit group, a capability sentinel for S9's general builder: a box prism split by four open-wire prisms (sheets), bopcheck and unifysamedom; the heal group loads XSDRAW.
S8e's bsplit group, a capability sentinel for S9's general builder: progress reports of the Boolean and splitter commands (XProgress); native makes no geometric query.
